specs-o.esr_esl_dc_bias_source-s: Würth Elektronik LTspice library LTSpice_WCAP-PSHP (rev22a, 2022-06-01; we-online.com WCAP-PSHP product page), subckt 875115652007_100uF: Rser 12.387 mOhm, Lser 5.291 nH, C 100 µF, Rpar 50 kOhm -> esr_mohm = Rser (frequency-independent model, so also ESR at SRF), esl_ph = Lser, srf_mhz = 1/(2 pi sqrt(Lser C)). Model values, not a measured curve; temperature not stated. Catalog: ESR 30 mOhm (max), ripple 3000 mA, 2000 h. Read 2026-10-21

component-o.description-s: 100 µF ±20% 35 V WCAP-PSHP aluminum polymer capacitor, SMD can 8 x 8.7 mm (land 8.3 x 8.3 mm), 30 mΩ max ESR, 3 A ripple at 100 kHz, 2000 h at 105 °C

non-technical-o.cost-source-s: DigiKey API v4 StandardPricing, USD, 2026-10-21: per quantity the lowest unit price among DigiKey's non-Digi-Reel packagings whose first break is at or below that quantity (732-11942-2-ND Tape & Reel (TR), 732-11942-1-ND Cut Tape (CT))
